messages.subject: Re: setar model
parts:
Setlhare

Thanks for reporting this problem (please also cc in the future to the
mailing list). It seems you have actually a warning and an error. The
warning is innocuous, but the error has to be considered...

The gird search will test for many models, sometimes for regimes with
small values. When there are a too small number of values, this can
create problems. Try augmenting the trim parameter. If this continue,
please send a minimal example to reproduce your problem encountered.

Concerning your plot, it kind of does. Reas Enders 2004 (Applied TSE)
for more insights on how to interpret those graphs.

Matthieu
